system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: fms_search_providers and fms_estimate_cost.. my service_type is dummy_service_type_5906, my land_area_acres is dummy_land_area_acres_3505, my location is dummy_location_7542.

function.name: fms_search_providers
function.description: Searches for service providers by service type and location. Returns provider details, ratings, and availability. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book. Fails if no providers match or location invalid.

function.name: fms_estimate_cost
function.description: Estimates service cost based on service type, land area, and duration. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT create bookings. Estimate is approximate. Fails if service type unsupported or area unrealistic.
